BEST_GLOBAL_TICKET_RANK_USED_BY_OPTIMUM.DEFINITION: smallest exact global rank (1 = best of 13,983,816) among the tickets of the pool optimum (lowest-SHA optimal set); diagnostic only

EXACT_REPAIR_CANDIDATES_SCORED_DEFINITIO: complete replacement sets scored exactly at solver leaves (each is one of the C(pool, r) candidates; the rest were eliminated by the safe bound)
GLOBAL_ENUMERATION_WALL_DEFINITION: wall time of the scoring pass over all 13,983,816 tickets (pair links, triple-free extension counts, exact lifting, marginals); top-48 selection, pool assembly, the local-pool comparison, the histogram and the solve are reported separately

GLOBAL_TOP48_NOT_IN_LOCAL_MUTATION_POOL.DEFINITION: global top-48 tickets absent from the five-ticket pilot's capped local pool (removed + pinned elites + exact-marginal one- and two-number mutations) built for the same destroy set; diagnostic only

NOT_CLAIMED: optimality beyond the six sampled destroy sets and their declared global pools
superiority or equality relative to protected Lane 3
PEAK_MEMORY_DEFINITION: ru_maxrss of the single pilot process (one worker, no children)

POOL_DEFINITION.A_REMOVED: the removed incumbent tickets (always retained first)
POOL_DEFINITION.B_ELITE: distinct tickets of the pinned V5, V6 and 313239661 portfolios that are not frozen in R (retained second)
POOL_DEFINITION.CAP_RULE: A, then B, then C until 64 tickets; a frozen ticket never joins the pool
POOL_DEFINITION.C_GLOBAL: the true top 48 of all 13,983,816 tickets by exact residual marginal, ties to the lexicographically lowest ticket (retained last, in global rank order)

SOLVER_DETAIL: DFS over pool tickets in descending single-marginal order; pruning only by the submodular remaining-slot bound (covered + sum of the r largest exact marginals) with a strict comparison so tied sets survive; the last two slots are solved exactly by a weighted Gram matrix; every optimal set is kept and ties break on the lowest normalized portfolio SHA-256; no heuristic prunes
TIE_BREAK: max exact count, then lowest normalized portfolio sha256
